identityStatus: Independent story identity Q2164598, the native foundation outline and the June 1904 published photograph agree on the location and eight-sided form. The caption provides exact design height, base and crown dimensions.

notes: The primary June 4, 1904 periodical photograph records the actual exposed timber and crown ribs. The caption measures 187 feet to the top, 154 feet to the structural head, 96 feet minimum across the base and 65 feet diameter at the cupola.
